_README: Labels, order and descriptions for every node of the category tree (SPEC-TREE.md). Key = the node's path joined with '/'. Pages never title-case slugs — a node reachable from any item path MUST have an entry here (scripts/build_data.py validate_tree_coverage warns when one is missing). Month/day levels under saints/synaxarion are calendar-backed (data/lectionary/days/<year>.json) and need no entries. 'children' fixes the display order of child nodes where the data alone can't.

church-year.label: The Church Year
church-year.description: Homilies kept in the Church's own rhythm — the Sundays, the great feasts, and the fasts that prepare for them.

church-year/sundays.label: The Sundays
church-year/sundays.description: The Sunday Gospels and Epistles, cycle by cycle. The Sunday homilies held so far are Chrysostom's commentary series — they file under Scripture Commentaries until the cycle mapping exists.

church-year/feasts.label: The Great Feasts
church-year/feasts.description: What the Fathers preached on the feasts of the Lord and the Mother of God.

church-year/feasts/transfiguration.label: The Transfiguration
church-year/feasts/transfiguration.description: The Fathers on the light of Tabor — kept on 6 August.

church-year/feasts/dormition.label: The Dormition
church-year/feasts/dormition.description: The Fathers on the falling-asleep of the Mother of God — kept on 15 August.

church-year/seasons.label: Fasts & Seasons
church-year/seasons.description: The fasts and seasons of the year — Great Lent, the Dormition Fast, and the rest — as texts for them are gathered.

saints.label: Lives of the Saints
saints.description: The saints of each day, and long Lives read a chapter at a time.

saints/synaxarion.label: The Synaxarion
saints/synaxarion.description: The saints commemorated each day, from St Nikodemos the Hagiorite's Synaxaristes — pick a month, then a day.

saints/lives.label: Lives in Chapters
saints/lives.description: Long Lives, serialised a chapter at a time.

saints/lives/andrew-the-fool.label: The Life of St Andrew the Fool
saints/lives/andrew-the-fool.description: A tenth-century Life of the holy fool of Constantinople, by Nikephoros, priest of Hagia Sophia — read a chapter at a time.

saints/lives/kosmas-aitolos.label: The Life of St Kosmas of Aitolia
saints/lives/kosmas-aitolos.description: St Nikodemos the Hagiorite's Life of the wandering preacher who crossed Greece and Albania building schools, and was hanged in 1779.

scripture.label: Scripture Commentaries
scripture.description: The Fathers' homily series on the books of Scripture, in chapter and verse order.

scripture/new-testament/matthew.label: Matthew
scripture/new-testament/matthew.description: St John Chrysostom's homilies on the Gospel according to Matthew.

scripture/new-testament/1-corinthians.label: First Corinthians
scripture/new-testament/1-corinthians.description: St John Chrysostom's homilies on St Paul's First Epistle to the Corinthians.

spiritual.label: The Spiritual Life
spiritual.description: Beyond the calendar — on prayer, on trial, on the wisdom of God, theme by theme.

spiritual/marriage.label: Marriage
spiritual/marriage.description: What the Fathers preached on marriage — the crowning of two lives, the raising of children, and the wounds of separation.

scripture/new-testament/2-corinthians.label: Second Corinthians
scripture/new-testament/2-corinthians.description: St John Chrysostom's homilies on St Paul's Second Epistle to the Corinthians.

scripture/new-testament/john.label: John
scripture/new-testament/john.description: St John Chrysostom's homilies on the Gospel according to John.

scripture/new-testament/romans.label: Romans
scripture/new-testament/romans.description: St John Chrysostom's homilies on St Paul's Epistle to the Romans.

by-author.label: Books
by-author.description: The Fathers' works gathered into books — choose a saint, open a book, and read it chapter by chapter.

by-author/st-tikhon-of-zadonsk.label: St Tikhon of Zadonsk
by-author/st-tikhon-of-zadonsk.description: St Tikhon of Zadonsk (1724–1783), bishop of Voronezh, recluse of Zadonsk.

by-author/st-tikhon-of-zadonsk/the-lette.label: The Letters Sent
by-author/st-tikhon-of-zadonsk/the-lette.description: 46 letters of spiritual counsel St Tikhon of Zadonsk wrote from his retirement at Zadonsk, 1769–1780.

by-author/st-tikhon-of-zadonsk/short-mor.label: Short Moral-Instructive Words
by-author/st-tikhon-of-zadonsk/short-mor.description: 28 short moral-instructive sermons St Tikhon of Zadonsk preached and published as a cycle at St Petersburg, 1784.

spiritual/gnomis.label: Opinion
spiritual/gnomis.description: On the hold our own opinion takes over us, and what it costs the soul.

spiritual/archontariki.label: Questions from the Parish
spiritual/archontariki.description: An evening of questions and answers on living the faith.
